# Reference fixtures

Three ISF sources and the expert `.frag` conversions this project produced for
them, kept as the public slice of the larger private oracle (17 pairs).

| file | origin |
|------|--------|
| `*.fs` | `ISF-shaders-main` (sleeplessmonk). Its bundled `LICENSE` is CC0 1.0; its README asks for non-commercial reuse. |
| `*.frag` | `converted_shaders/` in the private repo - expert conversions by this project. |

They are test fixtures only, not shipped shader content. The remaining 14
pairs stayed private (corpus material, not package material); see
`tests/README.md` for the full drop list.
